name: Lg Cns
summary: LG CNS Co., Ltd., a global IT service provider headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, delivers a comprehensive array of technology solutions both domestically and internationally. The company's extensive offerings are centered around cloud computing, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. Its cloud services include consulting, migration, implementation, application modernization, and managed support, featuring integrated solutions like CloudXper for complete cloud transformations and CloudXper ProOps for holistic operational management. Beyond cloud, LG CNS provides advanced data center solutions and its SINGLEX software-as-a-service (SaaS) platform, which spans a wide spectrum of enterprise functions from supply chain and manufacturing to human resources, finance, and AI-powered business management. The firm is also a leader in smart technologies, offering its Factova smart factory platform, intelligent logistics, and smart city infrastructure. LG CNS actively develops cutting-edge blockchain solutions, including the Monachain platform, the Tidit mobile employee ID, and the Monachian TaaS token API. It drives digital transformation initiatives across the financial and public sectors, while also enhancing customer engagement through digital experience platforms and data-driven marketing solutions. Furthermore, its technology portfolio encompasses various specialized development and management tools such as DevOn for no-code development, PerfecTwin for parallel verification, the LENA web application server, TunA for application performance management, J-Jobs for workload automation, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems. The company also delivers sophisticated AI and data solutions, including its enterprise generative AI platform (DAP), big data analytics, AI tutors, chatbots, and MyData services, all safeguarded by its robust SecuXper security platform. Established in 1987 as LG-EDS Systems, the company adopted its current name, LG CNS Co., Ltd., in January 2002.
